name: Aquatic Ecology, Fish Behavior & Underwater Life System
design_rules: fish behavior is driven by habitat conditions rather than random wandering
schooling species preserve cohesion while reacting to threats
territorial species defend a local radius instead of chasing indefinitely
bottom species prefer low vertical movement and sheltered substrate
player proximity increases fear response according to species temperament
poor depth, current or turbidity conditions reduce habitat suitability
aquatic populations respond to food density and carrying capacity
aquatic life never uses emissive or glow feedback
